title: Storage
prompt: Front-facing editorial photograph of an open kitchen storage cabinet on a seamless warm light-grey background, no room, no walls, no windows. A warm birch wood cabinet with both doors opened symmetrically. On the upper shelf: two cream fabric storage boxes with simple lids and two small beige woven baskets holding neatly folded towels. On the lower shelf: a natural bamboo drawer organizer divided into compartments with folded cloths. The drawers are wood-fronted, not metal, with no metal faces and no metal handles. Camera level at 20 degrees above horizontal, straight-on parallel projection, shelf edges perfectly horizontal, vertical edges perfectly vertical, no perspective convergence, no skew, 50mm lens, no wide-angle distortion. Every object fully visible inside the frame with clear gaps, nothing cropped, restrained warm neutral palette, photorealistic, soft daylight, no people, no text, no logos.
